purpose: Define the final machine-readable release/replacement gate for a Contract Format 1.4 canonical tree, composing repository acceptance, evidence freshness, regression status and explicit approval.

topics.name: Canonical Release Gate
topics.purpose: Define the final machine-readable release/replacement gate for a Contract Format 1.4 canonical tree, composing repository acceptance, evidence freshness, regression status and explicit approval.

semantics.blocked_rule: Any mandatory failing/incomplete dimension, stale evidence or unresolved regression blocks release.
semantics.ready_rule: ready_for_approval means all machine gates pass but explicit approval has not yet been recorded.
semantics.approval_rule: approved requires explicit authorized approval and exact candidate snapshot identity.
semantics.replacement_rule: Only approved candidate is eligible to replace the current canonical tree.
semantics.change_rule: Any semantic change after approval invalidates approval for the changed snapshot and returns the candidate to validation.
semantics.lock_rule: Repository-level locked/released state traces to the exact approved evidence bundle.
semantics.rollback_rule: Release metadata preserves previous accepted snapshot for rollback/recovery.

invariants.rule: Validation outcomes, findings, exceptions, evidence, baselines and release decisions are explicit machine-readable facts and never silently rewrite source semantics.

hard_gates.condition: release proceeds with failing/incomplete mandatory dimension
approved snapshot changed without invalidating approval

references.purpose: Release is tied to immutable current evidence.
Approved release candidate may replace the old tree.
